title.narrative: Public Accountability and Service Delivery (PASEDE) programme

description.narrative: The general objective of the action is to promote macro-fiscal stability, service delivery and poverty alleviation in Kenya. The specific objectives of the action are (i) improved financial transfers to counties; (ii) enhanced revenue mobilisation; (iii) improved business environment; and (iv) better public investment management practices.
